- No file changes detected; documentation and usage info remain the same.
- Skill description and detailed rules for academic discussion summarization unchanged.
- No functional updates or new features in this version.
- All ASR/TTS integration, prompt usage, and command-line workflow instructions are as before.

Academic Discussion Assistant – Initial Release

- Converts small-group academic discussion recordings (e.g., meetings between advisor and graduate students) into structured meeting summaries.
- Separates speakers using SenseAudio ASR, and generates original transcript, diarized transcript, and formatted summary.
- Extracts teacher/advisor suggestions, student responses, required changes, and follow-up actions.
- Produces a concise audio summary using SenseAudio TTS and returns as a chat media attachment.
- Enforces strict handling of API keys, file sizes, and always prioritizes accurate speaker identification and structured output.
- Designed for 2–3 participant discussions, particularly in research and academic environments.
